recognize_zh: 周邊血液 CellaVision 圖庫中是一致的中小型芽細胞：高核質比、細緻染色質、核仁不明顯、胞質稀少淡藍；流式顯示 CD45 弱至陰性芽細胞表現 CD19、CD34、CD10（強）、HLA-DR，缺 CD20 與 CD13/CD117，且三天內芽細胞由 4% 升至 43%，符合 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Uniform small to intermediate blasts, about 1.5-2 times a red cell diameter, with very high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine to slightly condensed chromatin and inconspicuous or small nucleoli
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, some cells with a small cytoplasmic tail or bleb; occasional small punched-out vacuoles or clear dots
Flow: CD45 dim/negative blasts (about 43-44%) positive for CD19, CD34, bright CD10 and HLA-DR; negative for CD20, CD13 and CD117
Serial flow: CD10+CD34+ blast fraction rises from about 4% to 19% to 43% over 72 hours
describe_en: Peripheral blood digital morphology images show a monotonous population of small to intermediate blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are seen. Flow cytometry of the peripheral blood identifies a CD45-dim to negative blast population positive for CD19, CD34, bright CD10, CD22, HLA-DR and CD58, and negative for CD20, CD117, CD13, CD33 and surface light chains. Serial studies show the circulating blast population increasing from 4% to 19% to 43% over three days. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, but T-ALL blasts express cytoplasmic/surface CD3 and CD7 and lack CD19 and CD22, unlike this CD19+CD22+ population.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts may look similarly agranular but express CD13, CD33 or CD117 and lack the CD19/bright CD10 B-lineage profile shown here.

Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum from CD34+CD10+ to CD20+ with normal CD45 and CD58 levels, whereas these blasts form a discrete CD20-negative cluster with high CD58 and rapidly rising counts.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are mature CD34-, TdT-, surface light chain-restricted B cells, unlike these CD34+ light chain-negative blasts.

captions: CellaVision gallery of peripheral blood lymphoblasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm
